meta.name: task-success-metrics
meta.description: Measuring whether the AI actually helped users accomplish their goals.

copy.tagline: 衡量AI助手是否真正帮用户达成目标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要量化AI助手的实际任务完成效果。
copy.tagline_en: Measure whether AI assistants truly help users achieve their goals.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quantify how well AI assistants help users complete tasks.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会引导你定义任务成功的标准（如完成目标、质量门槛），并通过完成率、耗时、交互轮次等指标，衡量AI是否真正帮你达成目标，而非只看输出质量。
howto.when: 当你想评估AI助手是否有效完成了用户任务，或需要定义任务成功标准、分析用户行为数据时触发。

say.text: 如何衡量这次对话的任务成功率？
帮我定义邮件发送任务的成功条件。
分析用户干预率高的原因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you define task success criteria and track metrics like completion rate, time, turns, first-attempt success, intervention, and abandonment rates to measure if the AI truly helped you achieve your goals, not just output quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to evaluate if the AI effectively completed a user task, or need to define success criteria and analyze user behavior data.

say_en.text: How to measure task success rate for this conversation?
say_en.note: Claude will propose metrics and methods.

say_en.text: Define success criteria for the email sending task.
Analyze reasons for high intervention rate.
